verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a root llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt and markdown versions of the agentic-commerce docs (.md URLs). Agent-oriented entry points are also documented: a one-prompt MPP build that tells the coding agent to read the .md doc, `link-cli --llms-full`, a machine-readable skills index at a well-known URL, and an MCP server that searches Stripe's documentation. Missing for 10: the probed llms.txt excerpt is truncated, so there is no evidence of agentic-commerce-specific content in it, and one community report says the MPP doc is sparse on end-to-end detail.
